scope: Prime fields p>3, nonsingular curves, arbitrary cyclic subgroup and promised valid target. Hand proof using cited encoding and graded parity bounds. No kernel verification or practical crossover.
statement: One Las Vegas classical prime-field index calculus returns a scalar in expected total bit time 2^{O(b/(log b)^beta)} for beta=0.5 log_2(1/H_2(3/4)), without a supplied base-point order or cofactor restriction. The bound includes setup, parity witnesses, integer elimination and scalar recovery.
